_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); subscription software signals with salesforce.com's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (CRM listed 2004-06-23)

pit_profile.why: 'We are the leading provider, based on revenues and market share, of software on demand, according to a July 2007 report by International Data Corporation, or IDC.' 'The market for CRM, enterprise business applications, and development platforms is highly competitive, rapidly evolving and fragmented, and subject to changing technology, shifting customer needs and frequent introductions of new products and services.' 'enterprise software application vendors including Amdocs Limited, Epicor Software Corporation, IBM Corporation, Infor Global Solutions, Microsoft Corporation, Oracle Corporation, and SAP AG;' (FY2008 10-K); DURABLE: no 10-K calls the business cyclical ('cycle' appears only as the sales cycle and payment cycles); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a subscription software company on this date (OFFSHORE, the one theme live, is scoped to IT services, and the 10-K's cloud computing words, where it has them, describe salesforce.com's own model, not a substitute for it), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY05-FY08 ex-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +40.9%/yr (Q1 FY09 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 3.8-yr ex-FY07 median

BULL.desc: EPS +40.9%/yr (FY05-FY08 ex-FY07 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +40.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY08 ex-FY07, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CRM (retrospective, 2008-03-28) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.21x (47.2% downside to Bear $30.03 / +227.7% upside to Bull $186.30) | Adj composite 2.03 vs market 1.36: gap +0.67 [UNDERVALUED] | +19% above the EPP floor $47.77 (147x FY09E $0.33) | Conservative 2-yr case: +149.1% total (+74.5%/yr) | At 174.9x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $75.18 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +50.4% YoY in Q4 FY08, forward revenues +43.5-44.7% (Q1 FY09 revenue guide (Q4 FY08 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
